practiceReport.name: Kenneth Walker III
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (74% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Did Not Participate (DNP) on Wednesday; remains sidelined from practice
practiceReport.beatComment: Walker has been sidelined for the Chiefs' last two games due to a sore groin and was listed as a non-participant in Monday's practice. Though the running back appears poised to take a step forward in terms of activity Tuesday, Reid's comments suggest that Walker will likely be a limited participant. The Chiefs will wait and see how Walker responds to practice Tuesday before having a better feel for his status for Thursday's game against the Bills.

practiceReport.name: Noah Gray
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: Kansas City didn't actually practice Monday, but Gray's DNP tag is nonetheless concerning with the club set to take the field Thursday versus Buffalo. Gray was injured late in Sunday's win over Arizona and didn't re-enter the contest. If the veteran tight end isn't able to suit up against the Bills, Jake Briningstool could see more work on offense as Travis Kelce's backup.

practiceReport.name: Omarr Norman-Lott
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Mid-week downgrade (Wed FP -> Thu LP); monitoring Friday clearance
practiceReport.beatComment: Norman-Lott missed Sunday's win over the Cardinals due to a knee injury. The defensive tackle was activated from the Chiefs' reserve/PUP list Wednesday and logged three limited practices during Week 11 prep. The upgrade to full participation, even for an estimated practice, is a strong sign Norman-Lott will be set to suit up for Thursday night's showdown with the Bills.

practiceReport.name: Peter Woods
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Woods ended Week 11 prep as a limited participant and did not play in Sunday's win over the Cardinals. The defensive tackle has now been listed as limited or better in four straight sessions, making a compelling case for his return to the field for Thursday night's primetime showdown with the Bills.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jared Wiley
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Wiley was carted to the locker room in the first quarter of the Chiefs' Week 10 win over the Falcons with an ankle injury. The tight end will now be on IR as he nurses his fractured ankle until at least the latter part of the regular season. Travis Kelce, Noah Gray and Jake Briningstool are now the only tight ends on the Chiefs' active roster.
